title: 双账本模型：跨云、模型与记录系统的多智能体AI系统交易粒度成本核算
summary: 论文指出企业AI成本仅在结算粒度汇总，无法回答单笔订单或案件消耗多少AI成本的问题，提出双账本模型：将符合FOCUS规范的结算账本与基于OpenTelemetry GenAI遥测的调用粒度归因账本关联，通过分层关联脊柱将每条记录归属到业务交易，并支持近实时定价与对账，仿真显示成本覆盖率超99%。
summary_en: The paper identifies a grain mismatch: enterprises receive AI cost only at settlement grain, so they cannot answer what a single order or claim cost in AI. It proposes the Two-Ledger Model, joining FOCUS-conformant settlement billing data to an invocation-grain attribution ledger built on OpenTelemetry GenAI telemetry. A layered correlation spine assigns records to business transactions, with near-real-time rate-card pricing and period reconciliation; simulation shows cost coverage above 99%.
